description: This script generates extension data for providers, routers, and objects by importing modules, extracting metadata, and writing JSON files.

methods.name: to_title
methods.description: Formats a string to title case, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: get_packages
methods.description: Retrieves package information from a directory, filtering out skipped folders.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to a JSON file in the extensions directory.

methods.name: to_camel
methods.description: Converts a snake_case string to camelCase.

methods.name: create_item
methods.description: Creates a dictionary representing a package item with specified attributes.

methods.name: generate_provider_extensions
methods.description: Generates provider extension JSON data by importing modules and extracting metadata.

methods.name: generate_router_extensions
methods.description: Generates router extension JSON data similarly for router modules.

methods.name: generate_obbject_extensions
methods.description: Generates object extension JSON data from specified modules.
